returns._immediatelyAvailableUBA: the amount on the core vault operating account - returns and redemptions within this amount will be paid out quickly
returns._totalAvailableUBA: the total amount on the core vault, including all escrows

returns._maximumTransferUBA: maximum amount that can be transferred
returns._minimumLeftAmountUBA: the minimum amount that has to remain on the agent vault's underlying address  after the transfer

params._lots: the number of lots, must be larger than `coreVaultMinimumRedeemLots` setting
params._redeemerUnderlyingAddress: the underlying address to which the assets will be redeemed;      must have been added to the `allowedDestinations` list in the core vault manager by      the governance before the redemption request.

params._lots: number of lots (same lots as for minting and redemptions)

params._amountUBA: the amount to transfer to the core vault

cancelReturnFromCoreVault(address).notice: Before the return request is processed, it can be cancelled, releasing the agent's reserved collateral.

confirmReturnFromCoreVault((bytes32[],(b.notice: Confirm the payment from core vault to the agent's underlying address. This adds the reserved funds to the agent's backing.

coreVaultAvailableAmount().notice: Returns the amount available on the core vault - this is the maximum amount that can be returned to agent or redeemed directly from the core vault.

maximumTransferToCoreVault(address).notice: Return the maximum amount that can be transferred and the minimum amount that has to remain on the agent vault's underlying address.

redeemFromCoreVault(uint256,string).notice: Directly redeem from core vault by a user holding FAssets. This is like ordinary redemption, but the redemption time is much longer (a day or more) and there is no possibility of redemption default.

requestReturnFromCoreVault(address,uint2.notice: Request that core vault transfers funds to the agent's underlying address, which makes them available for redemptions. This method reserves agent's collateral. This may be sent by an agent when redemptions dominate mintings, so that the agents are empty but want to earn from redemptions. NOTE: only agent vault owner can call NOTE: there can be only one active return request (until it is confirmed or cancelled).

transferToCoreVault(address,uint256).notice: Agent can transfer their backing to core vault. They then get a redemption requests which the owner pays just like any other redemption request. After that, the agent's collateral is released. NOTE: only agent vault owner can call
